ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $ \angle AOC=90^\circ$, $OD$ bisects $ \angle AOB$, $ \angle COD=35^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $ \angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Because $OD$ bisects $\angle AOB$, \\
therefore $\angle AOD = \angle BOD = \frac{1}{2} \angle AOB$, \\
because $\angle AOC = 90^\circ$, $\angle COD = 35^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle BOD = \angle AOD = 90^\circ - 35^\circ = 55^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle BOC = \angle BOD - \angle COD = 55^\circ - 35^\circ = \boxed{20^\circ}$.
